scenes.heading: Seasonal switch from heat to rain
scenes.summary: Scorching days transition into drenching monsoon rains.
scenes.rationale: Visual hook contrasting dry heat and wet rain.

scenes.heading: Seasonal wind reversal begins
scenes.summary: Summer monsoon starts with wind direction shift.
scenes.rationale: Seasonal contrast without presenting ITCZ movement as the sole trigger.

scenes.heading: Differential heating drives pressure
scenes.summary: Land heats faster than ocean, lowering pressure.
details: Helps lower pressure over the heated land.
scenes.rationale: Contrasts thermal properties to explain pressure gradient.

scenes.heading: Moisture moves inland
scenes.summary: Winds carry ocean water from seas inland.
scenes.rationale: Atmospheric illustration of humid air moving from sea.

scenes.heading: Moving rain belt organizes circulation
scenes.summary: Tropical rain belt shifts north, organizing circulation.
scenes.rationale: Visualizes the dense cloud band of the ITCZ.

scenes.heading: Rising air builds rain clouds
scenes.summary: Rising air cools; condensation forms clouds that can rain.
details: Cooling helps vapour condense into cloud droplets.
Cloud droplets can grow into rain.
scenes.rationale: Distinguishes cloud formation from possible precipitation.

scenes.heading: Mountains lift winds for rain
scenes.summary: Western Ghats force winds up, causing rain.
scenes.rationale: Illustrates orographic lift on windward slopes.

scenes.heading: Rain varies in place and time
scenes.summary: Terrain shapes location; wet spells and breaks shape rhythm.
scenes.rationale: Shows rain shadow effect, implying spatial distribution.

scenes.heading: Rains sustain life and crops
scenes.summary: June-September rains support agriculture and water.
scenes.rationale: Focuses on the vital outcome for agriculture.

scenes.heading: One connected monsoon system
scenes.summary: Heat, winds, moisture, and rhythm connect.
details: Land-ocean heating helps organize seasonal circulation.
Rising moist air cools and forms clouds.
scenes.rationale: Synthesizes the key drivers into a sequential summary.
